hypothesis: Normalization dominates fixed risk-feature extraction. Once a finite differently normalized competitor is found, a candidate with finite representable margin <= that best margin cannot replace it. Skip only its text normalization; keep all-window enumeration, first-tie semantics, validation and original arithmetic.

correctness.required: Exact complete feature/diagnostic records, fixed-head scores and 0.7 decisions; zero differences. Historical evaluation is implementation replay, never new confirmation. Synthetic checks must retain cross-window second-best and duplicate-answer semantics, mask/offset validation, missing alternatives and overflow rejection.
correctness.head: rebuild once per process from archived training matrix; no new fitting choices

performance.timing: Separate feature-only and full warm request including tokenizer, CPU ORT, decode, five features, score, parse and threshold decision. Excludes initialization/verification/JSON I/O; report initialization separately. Same eight historical single-window inputs. No concurrency or tail-latency claim.
performance.summary: median of three process medians per arm; paired ratio uses neighboring reference/pruned processes
performance.note: Feature runtime reduction >=20%; full request speedup >=1.05. Timing observations, not statistical guarantee.

limits.training: No base/adapter training; only existing 256x5 head reconstruction.
limits.stop: Any semantic mismatch or gate failure prevents runtime adoption. Fix correctness/harness defects with preserved failures; no threshold/data/precision/thread/search changes to obtain a favorable measurement.

adoption: If all gates pass, use the new exact extractor at the local prototype entrypoint only. Keep the historical reference, evidence bytes and pinned reproduction commands unchanged. Push a draft PR, no merge/tag/Release.
authorship: AI-assisted implementation and execution; personal mastery unverified.
